how_it_arrives: An outbound call from FarmerChat's number inside send hours. Two silent prompts in a row end the call and the answers so far are saved as partial.
opening: Hello, this is a call from FarmerChat. We have two short questions about the advice you got. You can press a key or say your answer.

items.say: Did you give the first irrigation to your wheat? For Yes, on time, press 1. For Yes, but later, press 2. For Not yet, press 3.
How does your wheat crop look now? For Green and healthy, press 1. For Some yellow leaves, press 2. For Many yellow leaves, press 3.

closing: Thank you. Your answers help us give better advice.
closing_if_follow_up: Thank you. We have noted this. FarmerChat will contact you again about it.
